searchText: man everyone here producing reports and we are "just trying to fix some random attestation processing post-fulu issue" 🙁 <@755590043632140352> & <@363800010518822915> could I get a review on this? https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4721 Also, I kinda want to rename `PayloadAttestationMessage` to `PayloadAttestation`. Is the "message" part there useful? This would mean renaming the gossip topic too. We already have a `PayloadAttestation` IMO this is what we should have done with attestations so I fixed it for the PTC the idea is that it has a clear index instead of a bitlist with a single bit set Ohh I see. Okay this makes sense. Ignore me 😅 ~~was thinking the same when reading the beacon api spec but didn't feel too strongly about it, but would give a +1 for renaming this~~ nvm
